userText: Last year I wanted to quit running because it was too tiring, but I told myself not to give up. Now I run every morning and I feel much stronger and happier.
aiRevision: Last year I wanted to stop running because it was too tiring, but I told myself to keep going. Now I run every morning and feel much stronger and happier.
errorSentences: 'quit running'虽语法正确，但A1学习者更常用'stop running'；'not to give up'结构稍超A1水平，A1更适合用简单祈使式或'keep going'；'feel much stronger and happier'中比较级和并列形容词对A1略难，可简化为'feel better'
suggestions: A1学习者宜多用基础动词（如stop, keep）和简单形容词比较级（如better），避免不定式嵌套（not to give up）；本句已很好体现坚持与积极变化，鼓励继续保持！
